## Change

`scripts/test_pages_workflow.py` compares the complete native `.github/workflows/pages.yml` file byte-for-byte with its reviewed contract. This rejects changes to triggers, permissions, concurrency, jobs, steps, commands, action pins/inputs, artifact path, deployment dependency/environment, whitespace, encoding and trailing bytes. `.github/workflows/site-checks.yml` runs the policy test in the existing read-only validation job.

The reviewed workflow itself did not change. No website source/design, services copy, price, research, PDF/ZIP download, production export, DNS, inquiry, payment, customer data, scanner, Birdy, held-domain or product-release file changed.
